tripRule: Trips are as reported in the covering email, which supersedes the workbook derivation.
movementRule: One movement is one transfer between locations: port to rig, rig to port, or rig to rig. Repositioning at the rig already occupied does not count, nor does a shift between two port-side locations.

movementsAudit.CA1: 1. JL-0003 to SH-0001 (30.09, Vessel E28), escorting OD1 during its rig move; arrival recorded 01.10 in report 28. Counted as rig position to rig position, and queried. Excludes the alongside and anchorage manoeuvres at OD1 on 25.09, 28.09 and 29.09.
movementsAudit.CA3: 3. OPH to Shuaiba (24.09, E5); MT Sedra II to OPH (28.09, E21); OPH to Shuaiba (29.09, E25). Excludes Shuaiba to MT Sedra II on 28.09, port to anchorage.
movementsAudit.CA5: 2. Shuaiba to OPH (24.09, E6); OPH to the OD1 new location (28.09, E22), before OD1 itself arrived there. Queried.

trucks.rule: Count truck and pickup units per movement. A dispatch counts as out, an arrival counts as in. An offload of a unit already counted on arrival is not a second movement, and a duplicated row sharing a delivery ticket is counted once.
